Application Data.NAME: Hobby Haven Supplies
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Hobby Haven Supplies operates as a retail store dedicated to providing a wide range of hobby and model-building supplies, including plastic kits, paints, adhesives, and tools. We also offer instructional workshops on model-building techniques and painting skills, ensuring a safe environment through comprehensive safety protocols and supervision. Our premises are well-maintained, featuring clear aisles and proper lighting, and we adhere strictly to local fire and safety codes. Our inventory control systems are robust, incorporating regular audits and secure storage to manage potential risks associated with high-value items. We actively promote a clean safety record with no recent claims related to injuries, reflecting our commitment to customer and employee safety.
